name: find_similar_molecules
description: Use this tool to find molecules that are structurally similar to a given SMILES string. This tool is appropriate when you have a specific SMILES representation of a molecule and want to explore similar compounds. Do not use this tool if you do not have a valid SMILES string or if you are looking for similarity based on other properties (e.g., biological activity) rather than structural similarity.

parameters.name: smiles_string
parameters.description: The SMILES representation of the molecule for which similar molecules are to be found. Must be a valid SMILES string.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: The maximum number of similar molecules to return. Must be a positive integer. Default is 10.

similar_molecules.description: An array of objects representing similar molecules.

smiles.description: The SMILES representation of the similar molecule.

similarity_score.description: A score representing the structural similarity to the input molecule, where 1.0 is identical.

return_schema.description: A list of similar molecules along with their SMILES representations and similarity scores.
